text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugahh!! Why won't it get betterrr!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh...! Curse you, pimple~...!
I don't wanna be on TV or have my photo taken
looking so uncool~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...If I don't cure this quickly,
it will tarnish my Demon King dignity...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...I should call Mom.
I'm sure she knows a good way to handle this..."
Shinko Windy seems to be troubled by rough skin...
